content:
Apple One bundles multiple popular Apple services with a discount, and in iOS 27, the high-tier Premier plan will receive several new benefits.

Apple One Premier gets two upgrades in iOS 27, both related to Apple Intelligence.

If you are already an Apple One user and need another reason to upgrade to Apple One Premier, iOS 27 might just give you one.

The new iPhone operating system brings two upgrades to the high-tier Apple One plan.

  • Apple Home AI Features
  • Higher image generation usage limits and other upgrades

Apple's Home app will introduce a series of AI features in iOS 27, some of which will be available only to subscribers of the 2TB iCloud+ plan. That means you need to subscribe to Apple One Premier or the top-tier standalone iCloud+ plan to use them.

It is still unclear whether all AI features require a subscription, or only some. The iOS 27 beta notes simply state: "Apple Intelligence for Home requires an iCloud+ subscription of 2TB or higher."

However, the upgraded features for HomeKit Secure Video will most likely require at least the high-tier plan. These features include generating video descriptions, searching within video clips, and flagging moments worth noting.

If you need a camera that supports HomeKit Secure Video, here are my recommendations:

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: priced at just $35, offering exceptional value
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: supports 4K recording, but is priced higher at $59

In addition, some of the new AI features in iOS 27 (such as image generation) have daily usage limits. According to Apple, Apple One Premier subscribers will enjoy higher usage allowances:

The iCloud+ plan bundled with the Apple One Individual plan does not qualify. Therefore, if you want higher AI usage limits, this is another reason to choose Apple One Premier.

The Apple One plan starts at $19.95 per month and also includes services such as Apple TV, Apple Music, and iCloud+.
